title: Kidney
examples: What is the main job of the kidney in the body?
How does the nephron clean your blood?
What happens if the kidneys do not work properly?

explain.say: Today we are learning about the amazing kidneys.
The kidney filters waste products from your blood.
Filtration happens in tiny structures called nephrons.
Next, useful substances are taken back into the blood.

items: Useful salts and water are reabsorbed

explain.say: The waste product urea is mostly removed as urine.
Dialysis is a machine that helps clean blood when kidneys fail.

faq.q: What is urea and where does it come from?
faq.a: Urea is a waste product made when the body breaks down protein. It is carried in the blood to be removed.
asks: What is the waste from protein?
Where does the body get urea from?

faq.q: Does the kidney only remove waste?
faq.a: No, the kidney also controls the balance of water and salts in your blood. This keeps your body balanced.
asks: Does the kidney just pee out waste?
What else does the kidney manage?

faq.q: What is the difference between filtration and reabsorption?
faq.a: Filtration is the initial filtering of blood waste. Reabsorption is taking useful things back into the blood.
asks: What happens after the first filter?
Is reabsorption the same as filtration?

faq.a: Dialysis uses a machine to filter waste from your blood when your kidneys cannot do it. It cleans the blood outside the body.

faq.q: How fast do the kidneys work?
faq.a: The kidneys work constantly, filtering blood many times every single day. This process is vital for survival.
asks: How much waste do the kidneys remove?

facts: The kidneys filter waste products from the blood.
The nephron is the microscopic filtering unit inside the kidney.
Reabsorption brings useful water and salts back into the bloodstream.
Urea is the primary nitrogenous waste product removed by urine.

quiz.say: The initial step of waste removal in the kidney is called:
quiz.why: Filtration is the process where waste is first separated from the blood.

wrong.0: This is what the waste product is, not the process itself.
wrong.2: This is when useful things are taken back, not the first step.
wrong.3: This is an artificial process used when the kidneys fail.

quiz.say: What process ensures that the body keeps necessary salts and water?
quiz.why: Reabsorption is the vital step of recycling useful materials back into the blood.

wrong.0: Filtration removes everything initially, including useful things.
wrong.1: This is the final removal, not the keeping process.
wrong.2: Dialysis is a backup system, not the normal process.

quiz.say: If a person's kidneys fail, what medical procedure might be necessary?
quiz.why: Dialysis uses a machine to perform the filtering job the kidneys cannot do.

wrong.0: More protein increases waste, making the problem worse.
wrong.1: The problem is a lack of function, not a need for a faster rate.
wrong.3: This suggests the problem is worse, not the solution.
